bed_day.text: You can't sleep now — it's too bright outside.

door_arrival_decision.text: Someone is knocking. Let them in?

door_arrival_skylar_bass_intro.text: Hey. Skylar Bass. I heard this place has paper-thin walls and no rules. You got room or what?

door_arrival_skylar_bass_about.text: Name's Skylar. I drum at night. I pay late sometimes, but I pay. Let me crash here and we both survive another week.

choices.text: Can you actually pay on time?
What are you bringing into my apartment?

door_arrival_skylar_bass_pushback.text: Yeah, fair. But hear me out for ten seconds and then slam the door if you want.

choices.final_text: Right. Loud and clear. Hope your walls keep you company.

door_arrival_skylar_bass_money.text: I can do two nights up front right now. After that, I hustle gigs and settle up every morning. If I'm short, I make it up fast.

choices.text: That might work. What about noise?

door_arrival_skylar_bass_rules.text: One duffel bag. No guests. No touching your stuff. I keep to the bathroom side and stay out of your room.

choices.text: You break one rule and you're out.

choices.final_text: Your loss. Stay paranoid in there.

door_arrival_skylar_bass_last_word.text: Then that's the deal. I pay, I keep my head down, and I don't make your life harder. Your call.

choices.final_text: Got it. I won't make you regret this.
Whatever. Door's your whole personality anyway.

door_arrival_rico_delgado_intro.text: Holy shit—someone's actually in there. The occupancy lamp just turned on. Please, don't hang up.

choices.text: How did you know I moved in?
Why are you at my door?

door_arrival_rico_delgado_pitch.text: That lamp means a new tenant with a company badge. That's you. I can pay $4 a day. Closet, bathroom, floor—I don't care.

door_arrival_rico_delgado_disclaimer.text: I know it's low. It's steady. I stay quiet, out of sight, out of your way.

choices.text: What happened to your last place?
No noise. No guests. No touching my stuff.

door_arrival_rico_delgado_counter.text: Then I keep walking till curfew sweep. You know what happens if you're outside too long. Everyone does.

choices.final_text: Okay... yeah. I get it. I'll keep moving.

door_arrival_rico_delgado_last_word.text: $4 each morning. I keep my head down. You won't hear a peep from me. Please.

choices.final_text: Thank you. I swear you'll barely notice me.

door_arrival_marcus_webb_intro.text: Marcus Webb. I run probabilistic budgeting. People say gambler because people fear math. I can cut your rent panic by half in one night.

door_arrival_marcus_webb_pitch.text: I need floor space, one flat surface, and permission to ignore small losses while we pursue strategic recoveries. You keep upside. I keep a corner.

choices.text: You're trying to parasite my panic.

door_arrival_marcus_webb_reveal.text: Small means recoverable. Usually. Also if I lose, morale drops, but statistically your future self thanks me for staying aggressive.

choices.text: You are a walking bad decision.
How often do you actually win?

door_arrival_marcus_webb_counter.text: No, Atlasco parasited your panic. I'm just offering premium coping mechanics.

choices.text: That might be the worst sentence I've heard today.

choices.final_text: Understood. I'll go optimize my disappointment elsewhere.

door_arrival_marcus_webb_last_word.text: Look, certainty is expensive. Risk is affordable. Let me in and we can both pretend those are different things.

choices.final_text: Excellent choice. Statistically, you've improved your week.
Fair. Certainty has a vibe, I guess.

door_block_day1_hungry.text: I'm too hungry I really need to find some food before work or I won't make it.

door_block_day1_too_early.text: it's still too early to go to work, let's not rush.

thought_day1_intro.text: wow this bed is way better than my last one. I should check this place out before work.

blood_extract_cooldown.text: The extractor is still recalibrating. Wait a bit.

blood_extract_pass_out.text: Everything goes white. Your knees buckle. You hit the floor before you can call for help.

thought_day0_intro.text: Welcome to your new home! Take a good look around then go to bed, we want you rested for work tomorrow!

thought_wakeup_day_1.text: that's the best sleep I've had in a while... but I'm hungry. I should go get a snack pellet
